description: CloudlessOS signed application and service catalog

apps.name: vLLM Engine
apps.description: High-throughput inference engine powering Cloudless AI.

apps.name: SGLang Engine
apps.description: Alternative high-performance inference engine (OpenAI-compatible).

apps.name: llama.cpp Engine
apps.description: Lightweight engine — runs on CPU+GPU and offloads to system RAM (GGUF models).

apps.name: Open WebUI
apps.description: Chat with your local LLMs — the face of Cloudless AI.
apps.tagline: Full chat interface for your local model.
apps.long: Open WebUI is a full-featured chat interface for your local models — the friendly face of Cloudless AI. Hold long private conversations, upload documents to ask about, tune system prompts, and switch models, all running on your own GPU with nothing sent to the cloud.
examples: Have long, private conversations with your local LLM
Upload a document and ask questions about its contents
Tune system prompts and switch between models
Revisit and continue your past chats

settings.label: Require an account to use it
settings.help: Off: anyone who opens Open WebUI can use it, no login. On: people must sign in with an account — the first account created becomes the administrator.

settings.label: Allow new sign-ups
settings.help: Let people create their own accounts. Turn off once your accounts exist to lock new sign-ups.

admin.note: Everything else about Open WebUI — users, model access, permissions, document/RAG settings and more — is managed inside Open WebUI's own Admin Panel (open the app, then top-right menu → Admin Panel). When you turn on account login, sign in with the built-in admin below (if Open WebUI asks you to create the admin instead, use the same details), then change the password right away — these are well-known defaults.

apps.name: ComfyUI
apps.description: Node-based image/video generation (Stable Diffusion, Flux, …).
apps.long: ComfyUI is a powerful node-based studio for image and video generation. Build repeatable pipelines with Stable Diffusion and Flux — text-to-image, inpainting, upscaling and more — entirely on your own hardware, with full control over every step.
examples: Generate images from a text prompt
Edit or restyle an existing photo with inpainting
Upscale images to high resolution
Design reusable generation workflows as node graphs

apps.name: AI Toolkit
apps.description: Ostris AI Toolkit — train your own image-model LoRAs (FLUX, SDXL).
apps.long: Ostris AI Toolkit is the ultimate trainer for fine-tuning diffusion models. From its web UI you can train your own LoRAs for FLUX, SDXL and more, on your own images — entirely on your GPU. The UI is protected by a password (default: cloudless).
examples: Train a FLUX LoRA on your own photos
Fine-tune SDXL on a custom style
Prepare datasets and run training jobs from a web UI
Export trained models to use in ComfyUI

apps.name: Unsloth
apps.description: Fast, low-VRAM fine-tuning for LLMs (Llama, Qwen, Gemma) in a notebook.
apps.tagline: Fine-tune LLMs 2× faster, with less VRAM.
apps.long: Unsloth makes fine-tuning large language models fast and memory-efficient — often 2× faster and with far less VRAM. This image bundles Jupyter Lab with Unsloth and ready-to-run notebooks, so you can fine-tune models like Llama, Qwen and Gemma on your own data, then export to GGUF or your inference engine. The notebook is protected by a password (default: cloudless).
examples: Fine-tune Llama or Qwen on your own dataset
Train QLoRA adapters that fit in low VRAM
Run ready-made fine-tuning notebooks
Export trained models to GGUF for local inference

apps.name: NeMo RL
apps.description: NVIDIA's scalable post-training workbench for SFT, DPO, GRPO, PPO, and agentic reinforcement learning.
apps.tagline: Post-train language and vision models with NVIDIA NeMo.
apps.long: NeMo RL is NVIDIA's open-source post-training framework. CloudlessOS installs the official multi-architecture NeMo RL 0.7.0 runtime and opens it as a persistent Jupyter workspace with the upstream examples, your shared Hugging Face cache, datasets, and training outputs ready to use.
examples: Run supervised fine-tuning or preference optimization
Train agents with GRPO, PPO, or custom rewards
Scale experiments with Ray across supported NVIDIA hardware
Keep notebooks, datasets, checkpoints, and model downloads locally

apps.name: NeMo Data Designer
apps.description: Generate, validate, and score synthetic datasets locally from notebooks or Python workflows.
apps.tagline: Design high-quality synthetic data with reproducible pipelines.
apps.long: NeMo Data Designer creates synthetic datasets from samplers, seed data, and language models, with validation and LLM-as-a-judge support. CloudlessOS provides a persistent notebook workspace, connects it to the private Cloudless network, and disables NeMo telemetry by default.
examples: Generate structured synthetic records from a schema
Augment an existing seed dataset
Validate rows with Python, SQL, or model judges
Call the loaded Cloudless model through its private API

apps.name: MoLT
apps.description: PyTorch-native agentic reinforcement learning with Ray, vLLM, and NVIDIA AutoModel.
apps.tagline: Research agentic RL in a small, hackable training stack.
apps.long: MoLT is NVIDIA NeMo Labs' agentic-first research framework for SFT and asynchronous reinforcement learning. CloudlessOS wraps the pinned 0.1.4 project image in a persistent Jupyter workspace. The published MoLT runtime is currently x86-64 only and targets supported data-center NVIDIA architectures.
examples: Prototype custom multi-turn agents and reward functions
Run SFT with NVIDIA AutoModel and FSDP2
Experiment with asynchronous vLLM rollouts
Inspect and modify the complete research implementation

apps.name: Axolotl
apps.description: Fine-tune language and vision models with reproducible YAML configurations.
apps.tagline: Configure and run LoRA, QLoRA, preference, and full fine-tuning.
apps.long: Axolotl is a flexible fine-tuning framework for language and vision models. CloudlessOS uses its CUDA 13 and PyTorch 2.12 Blackwell runtime on both x86-64 and ARM64, adds a persistent Jupyter workspace, and shares the system model cache, datasets, and outputs.
examples: Fine-tune a model using a readable YAML recipe
Train LoRA or QLoRA adapters
Run preference optimization and multimodal training
Export checkpoints for a Cloudless inference recipe

apps.name: OpenClaw
apps.description: Open-source personal AI agent that takes actions on your machine. Pre-wired to Cloudless AI.
apps.long: OpenClaw is an open-source autonomous agent that takes real actions on your machine — reading files, running tools, and chaining steps to finish a task. It comes pre-wired to Cloudless AI, so there's nothing to set up: just tell it what you need.
examples: Ask it to explain or refactor code in a project
Automate multi-step tasks using tools
Have it read files and answer questions about them
Let it draft and run commands on your behalf

settings.label: AI endpoint
settings.help: OpenAI-compatible URL OpenClaw sends requests to.

settings.label: Model name
settings.help: Display name shown for the model.

apps.name: Hermes
apps.description: Nous Research's personal agent and dashboard, integrated with Cloudless AI.
apps.tagline: A persistent local agent with tools and memory.
apps.long: Hermes is a personal AI agent from Nous Research with persistent memory, tools, scheduled tasks and messaging integrations. CloudlessOS opens its local dashboard directly and connects it to the active Cloudless AI engine, so chats and model inference stay on this machine.
examples: Use the local dashboard for persistent agent conversations
Chat with your AI from Telegram or Discord
Run tool-assisted tasks and scheduled automations
Keep memory and context across sessions and upgrades

settings.label: Allow all users
settings.help: Let anyone message the agent (otherwise use the allowlist below).

apps.name: Cloudless Transcription
apps.description: Private speech-to-text powered by Whisper-compatible models.
apps.tagline: Transcribe audio without sending it away.
apps.long: A local OpenAI-compatible transcription service for applications, workflows and the Cloudless voice experience.

apps.name: Cloudless Voice
apps.description: Private, natural text-to-speech powered by Kokoro.
apps.tagline: Give local applications a natural voice.
apps.long: An OpenAI-compatible speech service that runs locally and can be used by Cloudless apps and workflows.

apps.name: SearXNG
apps.description: Search the web through a private local SearXNG instance.
apps.tagline: Private web search for people and agents.
apps.long: A local metasearch service used by Cloudless research tools and Hermes without handing one provider your complete search history.

apps.name: Qdrant
apps.description: Local vector database for private retrieval and long-term knowledge.
apps.tagline: Store private embeddings and retrieval indexes.
apps.long: Qdrant stores the semantic index used by local RAG and research workflows. Its API remains internal to CloudlessOS.

apps.name: Hugging Face TEI
apps.description: Local text embeddings for semantic search and RAG.
apps.tagline: Turn documents into a searchable semantic index.
apps.long: A local Hugging Face TEI service used by knowledge and retrieval applications.

apps.name: Perplexica
apps.description: Deep research across private search and the active Cloudless model.
apps.tagline: Research a subject using local reasoning and private search.
apps.long: Perplexica combines SearXNG results with the active Cloudless model to produce sourced research without a hosted research subscription.

apps.name: n8n
apps.description: Visual workflow automation connected to local AI.
apps.tagline: Build automations that use your local model.
apps.long: n8n provides a visual workflow builder for scheduled jobs, APIs, databases and AI-powered automations.

packs.name: Cloudless Voice
packs.description: Private speech-to-text and natural text-to-speech services for local apps and agents.
packs.tagline: Let local apps and agents listen and speak.
packs.long: Cloudless Voice adds a private audio layer to this machine. It combines local speech recognition with natural text-to-speech, so compatible apps and agents can transcribe recordings, understand spoken requests, and answer with a voice without sending audio to a hosted provider.
examples: Transcribe meetings, interviews, and voice notes locally
Add spoken responses to assistants and automations
Build private voice interfaces using OpenAI-compatible APIs
Keep recordings and generated speech on your own machine

packs.name: Private Knowledge
packs.description: Local embeddings and a private vector index for retrieval-augmented generation.
packs.tagline: Give local AI a searchable private memory.
packs.long: Private Knowledge provides the local building blocks for retrieval-augmented generation. An embedding service turns documents into searchable meaning, while a private vector database stores the resulting index. Cloudless apps and workflows can then retrieve relevant passages before asking the active model to answer.
examples: Build a private knowledge base from internal documents
Retrieve relevant passages before generating an answer
Store semantic indexes locally instead of in a hosted database
Connect RAG pipelines and agents through local APIs

packs.name: SearXNG
packs.description: Private metasearch integrated with Cloudless apps and agents.
packs.tagline: Private metasearch for you and your local agents.
packs.long: SearXNG gathers results from multiple search sources through an interface hosted on this machine. Cloudless configures it as the private search endpoint for research tools, workflows, and agents without disguising which application is being installed.
examples: Search the web from a private local interface
Give Hermes and research tools access to current information
Use one local search endpoint across workflows and applications
Reduce dependence on a single search provider

packs.name: Perplexica
packs.description: AI research using SearXNG and the active Cloudless model.
packs.tagline: Sourced research, preconfigured for Cloudless AI.
packs.long: Perplexica combines SearXNG results with the model already running on CloudlessOS. Cloudless installs and connects both services automatically, while keeping the application name and every installed dependency visible.
examples: Research a topic and receive a structured, sourced answer
Compare information across multiple web sources
Explore follow-up questions with the active local model
Keep research synthesis on your own accelerator

packs.name: n8n
packs.description: Visual workflow automation integrated with the local Cloudless model.
packs.tagline: Workflow automation, integrated with Cloudless AI.
packs.long: n8n is a visual automation studio for connecting schedules, webhooks, APIs, files, databases, and AI models. Cloudless installs the standard n8n application locally and makes it available inside the CloudlessOS experience.
examples: Run scheduled jobs that call the active Cloudless model
Connect local files, databases, webhooks, and external APIs
Build repeatable approval and data-processing workflows
Automate AI tasks through a visual editor
